# Lorem Ipsum Generator

> Browser-based placeholder-text tools for design mockups, layouts, and prototypes.

Classic Lorem Ipsum generates neutral pseudo-Latin text. Themed Ipsum uses topic-specific vocabulary from six themes: Corporate, Tech, AI, Design, Fashion, and Zombie.

Both generators support exact counts for words and paragraphs, sentences, or characters. Results can be copied as plain text or HTML paragraphs. Text generation runs locally in the browser.

The interface and usage guides are available in English, Italian, Spanish, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, and Hungarian. Themed text can be generated in these ten languages.

## Tools

- [Classic Lorem Ipsum](https://lorem-generator.com/): Neutral pseudo-Latin generator, sizing tools, and usage guides.
- [Themed Ipsum](https://lorem-generator.com/themed-lorem-ipsum/): Topic-based generator, theme cards, a Classic vs Themed comparison, quantity guidance, and FAQ.
- [Asian Languages Text Generator](https://lorem-generator.com/it/testo-segnaposto-lingue/): Exact-count placeholder text in Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and Korean.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://lorem-generator.com/sitemap.xml): Index of the public Classic, Themed, and Italian Asian Languages pages.
